# Topology Matrix v0.1

| Source / Work | Default topology |
|---|---|
| W2 + S0 | Primary A -> Blind Recall -> Union -> Precision |
| W2 + S1 | Primary A -> Blind Recall + targeted literal passes -> Union -> Precision |
| W2 + S2 heterogeneous | Primary + targeted specialist passes -> Union -> Precision |
| W2 + S2 semantic-dense | Dual independent primaries -> disagreement/union -> Precision |
| W3 or S3 | Tier B primary -> independent adversary -> validators -> bounded adjudication |

## Never default
- majority-vote truth
- unlimited review loops
- all specialist passes on every page
- cheap-first on known W3/S3 work
